Vice Premier Wang Yang

A visit to Beike by the leading reformers in China’s top leadership, Vice Premier Wang Yang, the fourth Vice Premiers of China in Premier Li Keqiang’s Government and Chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference.
